mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question (user_id,question_id,wrong_count,status,last_wrong_time) VALUES (#{userId},#{questionId},1,0,NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wrong_count = wrong_count+1, status = 0, last_wrong_time = NOW(), update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_question wq JOIN question q ON q.id = wq.question_id AND q.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id

SELECT wq.id, wq.question_id, q.title, q.difficulty, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, wq.wrong_count, wq.correct_count, wq.status, wq.last_wrong_time, wq.last_review_time FROM wrong_question wq JOIN question q ON q.id = wq.question_id AND q.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id
ORDER BY wq.status ASC,wq.last_wrong_time DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{query.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) >0 FROM wrong_question wq INNER JOIN question q ON q.id = wq.question_id AND q.is_deleted = 0 WHERE wq.user_id = #{userId} AND wq.question_id = #{questionId}
